# The fleets of the Shoal. The two common wreck fleets are spawned by the mod
# once per run (already disabled); the rest are spawned by the mod as the belt
# heats up. Wrecks are derelicts of "Shoal Drowned" and carry
# no random cargo; their glass is aboard as installed material.
#
# v0.3.5 (DESIGN.md section 21): the derelict wreck fleets also roll Warden
# Cores per ship, carried in the hold ("<ship> [Core c]" copies, combined with
# the cutlass roll as "[Core c, Cutlass n]"), independently of the exotics and
# the cutlasses: Shoal Wrecks 20% one, Shoal Glass Wrecks 15% one, Shoal Rich
# Wrecks 40% one and 10% two, Shoal Deep Wreck always two or three.
#
# v0.3.4 (DESIGN.md section 19): every drowned pool (these fleets and the
# salvage leads' npc fleets) also rolls Glass-Edge Cutlasses for each drowned
# warship, independently of the exotics: tools/h2h/h2h.py expands each variant
# into every combination of its warships' rolls ("<ship> [Cutlass n]", in
# "shoal cutlass ships.txt"). The variant weights in the drowned fleets are
# after that expansion (divided by their gcd); the comments give the
# weights before it.

# Common wrecks: one or two drowned hulls with a little glass (6 to 15 each).
# v0.3: the old weights x3, plus one "(Worn, X)" variant per exotic line at
# weight 7 carrying that line's Mk I and 10 glass: 84 in 1026, 8.2% of spawns.
# v0.3.4: thirteen lines; everything x13 and each line 84 (still 8.2%).
